headline: Apple Quietly Hikes AppleCare+ Prices for New Macs and iPads
reasoning: This topic scores highly across the board due to its focus on Apple, a brand with immense mainstream appeal and clickability. The subject of a price increase, even a minor one, has high practical value for consumers and naturally sparks debate, boosting its viral potential. Furthermore, the story is a perfect launchpad for various engaging formats like 'Is it worth it?' explainers, listicles on insurance alternatives, and hot takes on Apple's pricing strategy.
summary: Apple has increased the price of its AppleCare+ extended warranty service for new Mac and iPad purchases. The cost has risen by $0.50 per month or $5 per year, following recent price hikes on the devices themselves.

source_articles.title: AppleCare+ prices just went up for Macs and iPads
source_articles.excerpt: Applecare+ prices for Mac, MacBook and iPad products just rose by $.50 per month or $5 per year.
